New message in #sales:

dave: @lobu who owns the Globex account these days?

input.text: @Dave — I don't have access to the account data in this session, so I can't look up Globex's account owner from here. Best bet is to search for "Globex" in the Owletto app (Accounts → search), which will show the assigned owner. If the app isn't handy, check with someone in #sales-ops and they can pull it from the CRM directly.
